        "Full15-path/1362-line owned diff and every changed browser/xpcshell assertion read. Adds scriptable EWS enum/properties, generic AccountManager EWS interface routing, persisted hidden path/radiogroup controls, reusable picker initialization and native server setters. The UI backing field is deliberately hidden, not an inaccessible visible control. Its real picker is labelled by the EWS radio. No rendered keyboard/accessibility result.",
        "The picker helper tears down cached popup state, assigns the new parent folder and initializes before selection. Dotted ews.trashFolderPath/ews.deleteModel remain data-binding names; visible ewsModelMoveToTrash/ewsMsgTrashFolderPicker are camelCase. The old hidden-element removal suggestion is rebutted and withdrawn after inspecting saveAccount/getAccountValue; prefstring controls lock lookup rather than replacing generic data binding. Existing dotted-ID knowledge is reused, not duplicated as a global naming rule.",
        "Native setters validate0/1 and destination existence, clear previous Trash flag, save relative path and set target flag. Empty path returns without clearing preference. AddSubfolder can adopt the distinguished server Trash when no path is saved, otherwise reconciles that new folder flag to the saved path. Error returns mean this is not atomic state replacement. In the owned phase folder GetTrashFolder searches root Trash flags, whereas the later accepted folder helper delegates to server path lookup; same method name does not mean same receiver or implementation.",
        "Deletion chooses hard delete for deleteStorage, an existing Trash folder, or the configured permanent model; soft deletion uses the destination CopyMessages machinery rather than the old copy-service route. The owned GetDeleteModel call stores rv but does not check it before using output, so no complete invalid-pref error guarantee is inferred. The newer HandleDeleteOperation design is not attributed to this landing.",
        "Listeners are forwarded into asynchronous move/delete callbacks. Historical OnRemoteDeleteSuccessful keeps rv=NS_OK while directly returning LocalDeleteMessages result; the guard reports the separate referenced rv, not that return expression. Historical nominal ItemCopyMove success has an explicit OnStopCopy plus guard completion; no exactly-once callback-count guarantee. Historical OnError only emits NS_ERROR and returns NS_OK, so success-oriented tests do not prove every remote-error listener settles. Current selected local-delete lambda assigns its result to rv; it is a later source phase. Other failure/owner paths remain bounded dependencies.",
        "New unit test waits PromiseCopyListener for deletion instead of polling local message counts after delete. The Promise helper rejects non-NS_OK status, but an already settled promise does not assert callback count. Initial sync/folder discovery still use waitForCondition in the owned test; URL-listener replacement is separate3226. Direct assertions cover default model/path/Trash flag and local folder message counts through changing target and permanent mode. They do not assert remote server deletion, all failures or callback counts. Later accepted unit assertions add target-flag/preference checks and sync helpers.",
        "Both historical/current unit task names DELETE_PERMANENTLY while respective IDL declares PERMANENTLY_DELETE. Browser task uses the declared PERMANENTLY_DELETE. Record this exact name mismatch rather than claiming the permanent-mode test establishes enum-name correctness; actual binding coercion/failure is untested. All added executable assertions have nonempty expected-behavior messages. selectAccountInSettings returns contentDocument despite its HTMLIFrameElement JSDoc; this mismatch persists in selected accepted helper. No test, build or lint ran.",
        "Public enum names omit redundant EWS_DELETEMODEL prefix under the interface/type scope; stored values0/1 are compatibility-sensitive. New JS functions omit the old a argument prefix locally, retain explicitreceiver/interface checks and use early returns/shorter disabled assignment. Copied legacy handlers keep existing names. These are scoped accepted examples, not a new global prefix, equality, declaration or parameter-format mandate.",
        "The fake server adds a successful DeleteItem response and removes referenced item-map entries; no error-response case is added. Relevant settings, native folder/server, promise and mock consumers are bounded exact code evidence. No installed account, server, deletion, UI, platform or accessibility run. Later renamed Exchange/Graph-capable source is separately identified and does not complete its own historical entries.",
        "Parent read full current Bug1915211 description/comments0–2, updates/footer and full Phab D257076 creation-to-final timeline plus all75actual submitted inline bodies. No summary histories. Reporter describes an empty/stale EWS picker after changing accounts and explicitly does not establish other account-type failures. Screenshot, Try jobs and later regression1979097 remain unread locators.",
        "Review proposals and adoption differ by role. Hidden binding-element removal is explicitly rebutted; reviewer later retracts the underlying prefstring model and accepts keeping generic type.attribute persistence. CamelCase IDs are adopted only for visible/nonbinding controls, with aria-labelledby changed to the actual EWS radio. Argument-prefix cleanup, early-return path conversion, scoped enum names, direct getters and status checks are source-confirmed examples, not global new rules. Some suggestions acknowledge copied code or are explicitly deferred.",
        "Frontend review asks for real visibility/hidden checks, initially enabled picker, user-like synthesized click, reused account server and enum constants; owned browser task implements these direct assertions. Native tests replace post-delete polling with PromiseCopyListener; this exposes missing intra-server listener forwarding, which the patch adds. URL-listener sync work is explicitly split into1978157/3226. The test still polls initial sync in this landing, so no blanket polling removal is claimed.",
        "Review also asks for role-correct listener guard naming, accurate newly-created-folder comments, named enum values and no duplicate completion. Final owned source has listenerExitGuard but still a separate explicit OnStopCopy in nominal ItemCopyMove success, and deletion return status remains separate from rv. Done/approval is therefore not proof every completion concern was fully resolved. Current selected local callback updates rv; broader later listener architecture remains a separate phase. Enum name mismatch in unit versus interface and iframe-vs-document JSDoc are kept as static conflicting evidence, not successful runtime assertions.",

Requirements to add UI tests and operation-completion waits are shown by actual changed tests; they do not establish all remote errors, failed-pref rollback, callback counts or accessible behavior."
